review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Maintain easiest and hardest heaps keyed by balloon count and opposite index tie-breaks. Counts change monotonically and solved flags never revert; lazy stale-entry removal gives valid extrema among unsolved tasks. Opponent solves of already completed tasks do not reinsert them. Every minute emits result, including after all tasks are solved.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
